description: A stereo reverb with a dry and wet control, which suits a mixer's send and return

params.text: Sets how long the tail takes to die away
Rolls the high frequencies off the tail, so it darkens as it decays
Sets how much reverb is heard against the incoming signal, all dry at one end of its travel and all wet at the other
Takes the effect out of the circuit, fading rather than switching so nothing clicks

inputs.text: The left signal the reverb treats
The right signal the reverb treats
Added to the DECAY knob, 10V covering the knob's whole travel
Added to the DAMP knob, 10V covering the knob's whole travel
Added to the DRY and WET knob, 10V covering the knob's whole travel
A trigger here takes the effect out of the circuit, and a second trigger puts it back

outputs.text: The left channel of the reverb blended with the incoming signal
The right channel of the reverb blended with the incoming signal

inputs.5: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
